contentText: More than nine months into the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas, two-thirds of Gaza's population is still facing crisis levels of food insecurity, according to a new UN report released on Thursday. The report warns that recent gains could quickly be reversed unless humanitarian agencies continue to receive sustained access to the enclave, along with adequate funding and stability. For more on the humanitarian situation, we're joined by Shana Low, Communications Adviser for the Norwegian Refugee Council's Palestine mission, speaking to us from Amman, Jordan.
